public static final class FarmTask.Builder extends com.google.protobuf.GeneratedMessage.Builder<FarmTask.Builder> implements FarmTaskOrBuilder
Harvests mature crops in a bounded area and replants crops that require it.
An omitted center follows the bot between scans.
